# Justice Armored Heroes — metrics
All tiles filter to `env == 'prod'` (editor and dev builds report `dev`). Retention, cohorts and step-by-step funnels live under **Usage** on the `jah-metrics` resource — they work off the same user/session mapping. Events auto-delete after 90 days.

content.query: customEvents | where tostring(customDimensions.env) == 'prod' and cloud_RoleName == 'jah' | summarize Players = dcount(user_Id) by bin(timestamp, 1d) | render timechart
content.title: Daily players

content.query: customEvents | where name == 'match_start' and tostring(customDimensions.env) == 'prod' and timestamp > ago(14d) | summarize Matches = count() by Mode = tostring(customDimensions.mode) | order by Matches desc
content.title: Mode popularity (14 days)

content.query: customEvents | where name == 'robot_select' and tostring(customDimensions.env) == 'prod' and timestamp > ago(14d) | summarize Picks = count() by Robot = tostring(customDimensions.cyan) | order by Picks desc
content.title: Robot picks — cyan side (14 days)

content.query: customEvents | where tostring(customDimensions.env) == 'prod' and cloud_RoleName == 'jah' and timestamp > ago(7d) | where name in ('session_start', 'menu_view', 'mode_select', 'match_start', 'match_end') | summarize Count = count() by Step = name | extend Order = case(Step == 'session_start', 1, Step == 'menu_view', 2, Step == 'mode_select', 3, Step == 'match_start', 4, 5) | order by Order asc | project Step, Count
content.title: Funnel counts (7 days)

content.query: customEvents | where name == 'match_end' and tostring(customDimensions.env) == 'prod' and timestamp > ago(14d) | summarize MedianMinutes = round(percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.duration_s), 50) / 60, 1) by Mode = tostring(customDimensions.mode) | order by MedianMinutes desc
content.title: Median match length, minutes (14 days)

content.query: customEvents | where name == 'boot_perf' and tostring(customDimensions.env) == 'prod' | summarize p50_ms = percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.load_ms), 50), p90_ms = percentile(todouble(customMeasurements.load_ms), 90) by bin(timestamp, 1d) | render timechart
content.title: Boot time to menu (p50 / p90)

content.query: customEvents | where cloud_RoleName == 'site' and timestamp > ago(14d) | summarize Count = count() by name, bin(timestamp, 1d) | render timechart
content.title: Website — views and play clicks

content.query: customEvents | where name == 'error' and tostring(customDimensions.env) == 'prod' and timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Hits = count(), Players = dcount(user_Id) by Message = tostring(customDimensions.msg), At = tostring(customDimensions.where) | top 10 by Hits
content.title: Top exceptions in the wild (7 days)
